content.text: Run exactly ONE native autoresearch experiment in this disposable checkout. Do not implement or edit any source, fixtures, tests, scoring or benchmark. Use init_experiment if required with metric critic_input_tokens, lower is better, The required ./autoresearch.sh already delegates to the benchmark. Call native run_experiment (timeout_seconds 900); it automatically runs that entrypoint. Do not substitute bash or a fabricated tool for native run_experiment. Read native tool errors and correct tool arguments if necessary. Use log_experiment to record actual metrics and checks. Parser-cap failures may exist in the original baseline; use actual output, never assume their count. Accuracy/attestation failures are checks_failed even when the token metric improves. Do not change files. After ONE successful run_experiment execution and log_experiment, return its metric and STOP.
